affection.en: If you have a soft spot for someone, you feel affection for them; you like them very much.
affection.zh: 如果你对某人“情有独钟”（have a soft spot），你就会对他们产生喜爱之情；你非常喜欢他们。

affection.en: Even if you raise a wolf puppy with care and affection, when it grows up, it becomes very clear that it is still a wild animal.
affection.zh: 哪怕你用心呵护地抚养一只狼崽，等它长大后，你就会非常清楚它依然是一只野狼。

affection.en: And even if you are more of a cat person, it must be hard to look at a puppy making “that face” and not feel some sort of affection towards it.
affection.zh: 而且，哪怕你更喜欢猫，看着一只小狗摆出“那种表情”也很难不对它产生某种喜爱之情吧。
